description: Report that an order marked delivered was not received. Only allowed within 24 hours of delivery. Writes to the chain: this prepares an unsigned transaction (an intent) for `signer`; nothing happens until you sign it with geode-local-signer and submit it with geode_submit_intent.

message.description: UTF-8 text, at most 2048 bytes; no control or invisible characters

problem_photo_or_youtube_url.description: https:// URL or empty string, at most 512 bytes

signer.description: Your account address (SS58). The transaction is prepared for this account; you sign it on your own machine with geode-local-signer.

name: geode_market_report_problem_not_received
title: Market: report problem not received
